role: held-out model-family replication of the natural adaptive-quota compatibility arm
prerequisites: terminal digest-bound nine-seed P2 causal audit
terminal Qwen3-4B natural adaptive-quota RULER audit regardless of its outcome
complete frozen Phi tokenizer-specific RULER dataset
sequence_policy: prefetch is allowed, but no Phi adaptive prediction may run before all prerequisites are terminal; prerequisite outcomes never select or cancel this cohort

benchmark.name: RULER
benchmark.paired_unit: same frozen Phi-tokenized RULER example under both compatibility arms

scorer_selection.rule: highest frozen Qwen3-1.7B row-weighted mean accuracy among direct fixed-per-layer ScorerPress candidates; lexicographic tie-break

excluded.pyramidkv: overrides compress() with its own layer allocation and would confound the compatibility controller
excluded.adakv_snapkv: already performs a distinct adaptive allocation
excluded.expected_attention: not in the direct score-compatible frozen candidate set

fixed+pins.selection: top scorer positions after forcing protected positions inside the same layer budget

cross-family-adaptive-quota+pins.layer_signal: normalized entropy concentration of z-scored current-layer scorer values
cross-family-adaptive-quota+pins.causal_prior: running mean of earlier-layer concentrations only
cross-family-adaptive-quota+pins.feasibility_rule: reserve feasible minimum and maximum capacity for every remaining layer; final layer consumes the exact residual
cross-family-adaptive-quota+pins.selection: top scorer positions after forcing protected positions inside the allocated layer budget

per_example_required_audit: all 32 layer allocations in causal order
configured and observed total kept tokens
fixed comparator kept tokens per layer
score concentration and controller time per layer
hot-resident bytes, peak HBM, latency, and operational failure

statistics.failure_policy: intention-to-evaluate; operational failures score zero and are never silently retried, truncated, or dropped

failure_reporting.scoring_policy: every allowed operational failure remains paired and receives effective score zero

claim_boundary: A passing result supports bounded transfer of the natural score-concentration quota heuristic to one held-out Phi-family RULER cohort at equal logical KV budget. It is not unchanged transfer of the synthetic P2 controller. It is not a second full natural-language suite, Phi-specific optimization, dynamic-serving evidence, or official DeepSeek-V4 evidence.
